name: Remedy
description: Griffin Conner, a med-school dropout having left in a haze of disgrace, is forced to return to Bethune General Hospital as its newest orderly and work alongside his family.

videos.title: To Catch a Thief - Part 1
videos.overview: When medical supplies go missing in a basement storage closet at Bethune Hospital, Transport and Housekeeping Department supervisor Frank Kanaskie sets up a hidden camera to find who’s responsible.

videos.title: Bad Blood
videos.overview: The Conner family is thrown back together in a haze of blood and confusion, as prodigal son Griffin returns to his second family home - Bethune General Hospital.

videos.title: The Homecoming
videos.overview: Griffin's first day as Bethune's newest porter is a rocky one, while Melissa forges an unlikely connection with the sister of a patient whose life she is scrambling to save.

videos.title: Testing, Testing
videos.overview: Brian resolves to improve his patient interaction after receiving several complaints, while Griffin forms an unlikely bond with a cantankerous war veteran. Dr. Tuttle refuses to consider Sandy’s diagnosis of a rare disease in a dancer.

videos.title: Shift/Change
videos.overview: When two babies die of a mysterious infection in the Paediatric ICU, Allen scrambles to find patient zero before Bethune General suffers a full-blown outbreak.

videos.title: The Beast Within
videos.overview: Bruno shocks everyone by making an obscure diagnosis that saves a patient’s life, and a momentous secret from his past is revealed. After being kicked by a patient, Sandy calls Melissa for help instead of Brian.

videos.title: Scary Bears
videos.overview: An offhand comment from Allen sends Melissa into a tailspin, while Brian desperately tries to atone for a past mistake.

videos.title: Tomorrow the Green Grass
videos.overview: When Rebecca is brought into the ER with a mysterious paralysis creeping up her body, Allen has to scramble to find out what's happening before it's too late.

videos.title: Shadow of Doubt
videos.overview: Griffin starts to spin out of control after a harrowing car accident evokes a traumatic event from his past and Bruno gives Mel some vital tips on purse string suturing.

videos.title: The Little Things
videos.overview: A tumultuous day at the hospital gives way to an awkward dinner with Brian’s family, leading to an astonishing revelation for Sandy.

videos.title: Quit the Horizon
videos.overview: Sandy struggles to say goodbye to Brian as her reconfigured family rally around to support her. Zoe and Griffin organize a labour stoppage after Lonnie is fired.

videos.title: Our Friend, Chaos
videos.overview: An explosion rips through the downstairs of Beth-H, changing lives there forever.

videos.title: When You Awake
videos.overview: When an injured firefighter develops curious and frightening post-op symptoms, Mel and Jerry clash over how to proceed.

videos.title: Playing Doctor Conner
videos.overview: Griffin is forced to account for his actions when a patient dies while under his supervision.

videos.title: Blood and Guts
videos.overview: Allen performs an extraordinarily rare and dangerous medical procedure, and Zoe’s mother turns up at Beth-H unexpectedly.

videos.title: Life in Technicolour
videos.overview: Exhilarated by her new romance with Cutler, Mel is uncharacteristically reckless in the operating room.

videos.title: Secrets and Lies
videos.overview: Cutler is drawn into a critical case with a husband and wife who are at odds over the treatment of her unexplained illness.

videos.title: Everything in Moderation
videos.overview: Allen works to diagnose a reclusive young woman’s illness, while Griffin begins to come apart at the seams.

videos.title: Looking for Satellites
videos.overview: Mel explores the significance of a literal and figurative broken heart, while Griffin embarks on a drug-fueled odyssey.

videos.title: Fight or Flight
videos.overview: A clumsy attempt at addressing Griffin’s drug problem pushes him further down the spiral.

videos.title: Day One
videos.overview: Mel does everything in her power to save a gravely wounded Sandy, while Griffin finally confronts the reality of his addiction.
